company_profile: Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider delivering cloud, data center, endpoint and security projects for enterprise customers.
title: AI Solutions Architect
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs AI pipelines and agent systems for messy real-world data, from a document-extraction agent over lab documents to LangGraph multi-agent and RAG applications with retrieval, automated evaluation and tracing. Makes practical choices between RAG, fine-tuning and agentic workflows, and ships with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Long-Form Media Insight Pipeline
bullets: Built a pipeline that extracts structured insight from long recorded meetings, transcribing audio, chunking transcripts with overlap and sending each chunk to Claude on AWS Bedrock with schema-enforced outputs.

Evaluated extractions against hand-labelled samples with LLM evaluators, added retries on malformed responses, and orchestrated the steps with Step Functions and Lambda, storing results in S3 and OpenSearch.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Solutions Architect role at Sycomp. My recent work has been turning messy inputs into production AI systems, most of all a lab-extraction agent that reads long, unstructured documents and a LangGraph multi-agent chatbot. What ties it together is caring about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

Sycomp takes on complex IT projects for global customers, and a role that turns fuzzy business problems into working AI pipelines is exactly the work I enjoy. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Ireland together and settle there long term.

I would bring a practical, evaluation-first way of building. My lab-extraction agent with Claude and Amazon Textract handles about 1,800 lab documents, and the evaluation pipelines I built with LLM evaluators and tracing reduced human review by 43%. Both started as ambiguous problems and became systems people rely on.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me thinking about failure modes early, because the users cannot afford a tool that breaks. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your customers.
